text: News Bungie has been hit with mass layoffs The worst kept secret at Sony has arrived. More talented devs lost due to mismanagement and greed. Bill Lavoy June 25, 2026 9:57 AM Bungie 1 Today, Bungie announced mass layoffs. This comes on the heels of the final update to Destiny 2. pic.twitter.com/ceJTcKMs23 — Bungie (@Bungie) June 25, 2026 With great sadness, we are announcing a reduction in force as we reorganize Bungie. As leaders of Bungie, past and present, we recognize Destiny 2 fell short of expectations these past several years. Following our final content update to Destiny 2, and with our future projects still in early incubation, we unfortunately could not continue operating at our previous size. We know this decision has a profound impact on the people affected, their families, friends, and teammates. While these changes are necessary to best position the studio now and for the future, that does not lessen the difficulty of this moment or the impact it has on those affected. Later, we will share more about that future with you all but today is not that day. Today, we wish to extend our gratitude and compassion to every member of the Bungie team who has been impacted and to those who remain. We hope you will do the same. It’s wild to me to see whoever wrote that press release (and however many folks read it and approved it) talk about Destiny 2 falling short the last few years in an announcement about layoffs. One of the biggest reasons for the game falling short was the talent and workforce that had already been laid off, forcing the remaining developers to reduce the scope of new experiences added since The Final Shape. Layoffs aren’t happening because Destiny 2 fell short, they are happening because Sony and Bungie leadership laid off so many people the game couldn’t possibly succeed and entered a spiral to its death. It’s also worth noting that Sony absolutely has the money to continue funding the studio without these layoffs. The truth is they don’t want to do it because it will impact shareholders, and they matter more to Sony than the developers who make their games. To everyone at Bungie who has been laid off, past and present, you deserved better than this.
